individual-data-points.explanation: This is a stacked composition chart of median promoter-state frequencies across Pol II ChIP-seq bins; it functions like a stacked area/line plot summarizing proportions across a continuum, not a simple bar-of-means chart, so individual points are not required.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The stacked bar/area chart shows median state frequencies with no error bars present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each row of the single-molecule stack represents one of the 2952 individual DNA molecules, so individual data points underlying the summarized state frequencies are directly displayed.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The single-molecule heatmap and adjacent state-frequency sidebar do not use error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The middle line of the box represents the median. The box displays the interquartile range (IQR), 25th to 75th percentile. Whiskers represent a distance of 1.5 x IQR.
